meta.name: five-zones-governance
meta.description: Use when establishing concentric administrative zones or assigning graduated obligations by distance from a capital. Structures five zones (五服) from 甸服 to 荒服, each with specific tribute and governance requirements.

copy.tagline: 按距离首都远近设定行政区域与贡赋义务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究中国古代政治制度或需要设计分级治理方案
copy.tagline_en: Set administrative zones and tribute obligations by distance from capital
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study ancient Chinese political systems or need to design tiered governance

howto.what: 装上后，当你要规划从首都向外辐射的同心行政区域时，Claude 会依据五服（甸服、侯服、绥服、要服、荒服）的层级结构，帮你划分每层 500 里的范围，并为每层指定具体的贡赋或治理义务。
howto.when: 当你提到要建立“五服”或“同心行政区”，或者需要根据距离首都的远近分配阶梯式义务时。

say.text: 请为我的王国设计五服，首都设在长安。
say.note: Claude 将按五服模型划分区域并列出各层要求。

say.text: 用五服系统规划从首府到边疆的行政区。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供首都位置，然后生成五层职责。

howto.what_en: When you need to plan concentric administrative zones radiating from a capital, Claude will structure them into five zones (Dian, Hou, Sui, Yao, Huang), each 500 li wide, with specific tribute or governance duties per sub-layer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention establishing "five zones" or concentric administrative areas, or need graduated obligations based on distance from a capital.

say_en.text: Design a five-zone system for my kingdom with the capital at Chang'an.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the five-zone model and list each zone's requirements.

say_en.text: Use five-zone governance to plan administrative divisions from the capital to the frontier.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the capital location and generate duties for each zone.
